datafield.subfield: by Arthur Hove ; illustrated with vintage zinc halftone cuts selected by John Thos Bennett
"The first essay was read over Madison's WHA radio in 1979 ... The plates were first used for normal newspaper purposes by the Wisconsin State Journal."

"This piece of literary & visual whimsy is printed on three shades of handmade Italian Roma which is made at the mills of Fabriano, & Arches Text Wove, a rag mouldmade paper from the Arjomari Mill in France. ATF Garamond Italic & Roman type is used throught the 146 copies. That makdes this our first book to be entirely set in that graceful face. Writer Hove kindly allowed Printer Bennett to do his will with these essays. And the printer would not have had this choice of illustrations without his brother-in-law, D.A.D., who gave him 150 pounds of discarded vintage halftone plates upon entering the family. They were snatched up for a 'song' at a Wisconsin State Journal house cleaning."--Colophon.
